C0987.title: Game for Peace Cracks Down on Spectate ESP: 10-Year Ban
C0987.summary: On July 10, 2019, Peacekeeper Elite published an official targeted enforcement notice against spectator wallhack cheating, which was then aggregated by media on July 11. The notice said that if players used a smurf account with wallhack software to spectate and assist a main account, both the smurf and main accounts would be banned for 3,650 days. The enforcement targeted a collaborative cheating path that abused spectator mode to avoid direct cheat detection on the main account.
